response.title: which small portable power station with an ac outlet is best under 200 dollars
response.answer:
For a small portable power station under $200 with a real AC outlet, I'd prioritize three things: battery capacity, AC output wattage, and portability.

My preferred brands in this price range are EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, and BLUETTI. I'd also strongly recommend an LiFePO4 (LFP) battery, which generally lasts much longer than older lithium-ion designs.

The sweet spot is approximately 250–300Wh of battery capacity and 300W or more of AC output. That's enough for charging laptops, phones, cameras, and running smaller electronics, without carrying a huge power station.
